fullText.simplified:
第14章、平安路的油饼店

    包厚安被关了四天，他吃了四天面条。这四天，藏花一直没有出现。
    第五天，包厚安说不想吃面条了，这时候，藏花终于出现了。
    包厚安说：“藏花，你为什么躲在外面？不敢见我吗？”
    藏花没有回答，安静了一会儿后，房间的门开了。光照了进来，房间里一下子亮了。包厚安的眼睛过了好一会儿才适应。
    两个人走了进来。一个是藏花，另一个是个中年人，和藏花差不多高，像是个下人，这几天给包厚安送面条的应该就是他了。
    “小侦探，你想吃什么？”藏花笑着说。
    “我想吃油饼。”包厚安说。
    “好，我让云叔去买。”藏花说。
    “我想吃的油饼只有平安路的一家店卖，这位云叔知道那儿吗？”
    藏花看了看他身边的下人，下人摇了摇头。藏花笑着说：“没关系，云叔会去找，一定能找到这家店。”
    下人点头，说：“好的，我去找。”
    “那家店很难找，你敢让我和云叔一起去吗？”包厚安问。
    藏花迟疑了，他看着包厚安不说话。
    “不敢？害怕我逃跑吗？”包厚安问。
    藏花笑了，说：“你跑不了。我和你一起去。”
    半个小时后，一辆黑色的小汽车从灰色的小楼里驶出。
    开车的人是藏花，下人云叔没有来，包厚安坐在后座。他系着安全带，一块大毛毯盖在身上，毛毯下的双腿和双手都被绑着。从外面看，他只是个盖大毛毯的怕冷乘客。这很正常，毕竟现在是深秋，外面也飘着寒冷的细雨。
    “既然这么害怕我逃跑，为什么还同意我出来呢？”包厚安无奈地问。
    “我只是有点儿好奇，想看看你到底要做什么。”藏花笑着说，“真的是为了油饼吗？”
    “真的是为了油饼。”
    “是吗？为什么呢？那家店的油饼真的这么好吃？”
    包厚安看着车窗外的雨，过了一会儿才说：“藏花，你有没有过七天没饭吃、饿得走不动的经历？”
    藏花没有回答，他看了包厚安一眼，等着包厚安继续说下去。
    包厚安说：“我有过。十一岁的时候，我一个人来到上海，身上没有钱，七天没有吃一点儿东西，饿倒在一家油饼店门口。有两个路人从那儿经过，他们看到了我，其中一个路人在店里买了一块油饼给我，那是我这一生吃过的最好吃的油饼。后来，只要饿了，我就会去那家店买油饼吃。”
    藏花笑了笑，说：“那个路人是个好人，你遇到了一个好人。”
    包厚安点头说：“是的，我遇到了一个好人。”
fullText.traditional:
第14章、平安路的油餅店

    包厚安被關了四天，他吃了四天麵條。這四天，藏花一直沒有出現。
    第五天，包厚安說不想吃麵條了，這時候，藏花終於出現了。
    包厚安說：“藏花，你為什麼躲在外面？不敢見我嗎？”
    藏花沒有回答，安靜了一會兒後，房間的門開了。光照了進來，房間裡一下子亮了。包厚安的眼睛過了好一會兒才適應。
    兩個人走了進來。一個是藏花，另一個是個中年人，和藏花差不多高，像是個下人，這幾天給包厚安送麵條的應該就是他了。
    “小偵探，你想吃什麼？”藏花笑著說。
    “我想吃油餅。”包厚安說。
    “好，我讓雲叔去買。”藏花說。
    “我想吃的油餅只有平安路的一家店賣，這位云叔知道那兒嗎？”
    藏花看了看他身邊的下人，下人搖了搖頭。藏花笑著說：“沒關係，云叔會去找，一定能找到這家店。”
    下人點頭，說：“好的，我去找。”
    “那家店很難找，你敢讓我和云叔一起去嗎？”包厚安問。
    藏花遲疑了，他看著包厚安不說話。
    “不敢？害怕我逃跑嗎？”包厚安問。
    藏花笑了，說：“你跑不了。我和你一起去。”
    半個小時後，一輛黑色的小汽車從灰色的小樓裡駛出。
    開車的人是藏花，下人云叔沒有來，包厚安坐在後座。他繫著安全帶，一塊大毛毯蓋在身上，毛毯下的雙腿和雙手都被綁著。從外面看，他只是個蓋大毛毯的怕冷乘客。這很正常，畢竟現在是深秋，外面也飄著寒冷的細雨。
    “既然這麼害怕我逃跑，為什麼還同意我出來呢？”包厚安無奈地問。
    “我只是有點兒好奇，想看看你到底要做什麼。”藏花笑著說，“真的是為了油餅嗎？”
    “真的是為了油餅。”
    “是嗎？為什麼呢？那家店的油餅真的這麼好吃？”
    包厚安看著車窗外的雨，過了一會兒才說：“藏花，你有沒有過七天沒飯吃、餓得走不動的經歷？”
    藏花沒有回答，他看了包厚安一眼，等著包厚安繼續說下去。
    包厚安說：“我有過。十一歲的時候，我一個人來到上海，身上沒有錢，七天沒有吃一點兒東西，餓倒在一家油餅店門口。有兩個路人從那兒經過，他們看到了我，其中一個路人在店裡買了一塊油餅給我，那是我這一生吃過的最好吃的油餅。後來，只要餓了，我就會去那家店買油餅吃。”
    藏花笑了笑，說：“那個路人是個好人，你遇到了一個好人。”
    包厚安點頭說：“是的，我遇到了一個好人。”

sentences.pinyin: bāo hòu ān shuō wǒ yǒu guò shí yī suì de shí hou wǒ yí ge rén lái dào shàng hǎi shēn shang méi yǒu qián
sentences.english: Bao Houan said, “I have. When I was 11, I came to Shanghai by myself with no money on me.

sentences.simplified: 七天没有吃一点儿东西，饿倒在一家油饼店门口。
sentences.traditional: 七天沒有吃一點兒東西，餓倒在一家油餅店門口。
sentences.pinyin: qī tiān méi yǒu chī yì diǎn'r dōng xi è dǎo zài yì jiā yóu bǐng diàn mén kǒu
sentences.english: I didn’t eat anything for seven days, and I collapsed from hunger in front of a deep-fried dough cake store.

sentences.simplified: 有两个路人从那儿经过，他们看到了我，其中一个路人在店里买了一块油饼给我，
sentences.traditional: 有兩個路人從那兒經過，他們看到了我，其中一個路人在店裡買了一塊油餅給我，
sentences.pinyin: yǒu liǎng ge lù rén cóng nà'r jīng guò tā men kàn dào le wǒ qí zhōng yí ge lù rén zài diàn lǐ mǎi le yí kuài yóu bǐng gěi wǒ
sentences.english: Two passersby walked by, and they saw me. One of the passersby bought a deep-fried dough cake from the shop for me.

sentences.simplified: 那是我这一生吃过的最好吃的油饼。
sentences.traditional: 那是我這一生吃過的最好吃的油餅。
sentences.pinyin: nà shì wǒ zhè yì shēng chī guò de zuì hǎo chī de yóu bǐng
sentences.english: That was the best deep-fried dough cake I’ve ever eaten in my life.

sentences.simplified: 后来，只要饿了，我就会去那家店买油饼吃。”
sentences.traditional: 後來，只要餓了，我就會去那家店買油餅吃。”
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái zhǐ yào è le wǒ jiù huì qù nà jiā diàn mǎi yóu bǐng chī
sentences.english: Later, whenever I was hungry, I would go to that shop and buy deep-fried dough cakes to eat.”

sentences.simplified: 藏花笑了笑，说：“那个路人是个好人，你遇到了一个好人。”
sentences.traditional: 藏花笑了笑，說：“那個路人是個好人，你遇到了一個好人。”
sentences.pinyin: cáng huā xiào le xiào shuō nà ge lù rén shì ge hǎo rén nǐ yù dào le yí ge hǎo rén
sentences.english: Cang Hua smiled and said, “That passerby was a good person. You came across a good person.”

sentences.simplified: 包厚安点头说：“是的，我遇到了一个好人。”
sentences.traditional: 包厚安點頭說：“是的，我遇到了一個好人。”
sentences.pinyin: bāo hòu ān diǎn tóu shuō shì de wǒ yù dào le yí ge hǎo rén
sentences.english: Bao Houan nodded and said, “Yes, I came across a good person.”

sentence_translations: Chapter 14: The Deep-Fried Dough Cake Shop on Ping’an Street
Bao Houan had been locked up for four days and had eaten noodles for four days.
Cang Hua did not appear during those four days.
On the fifth day, Bao Houan said he didn’t want to eat noodles anymore. This was when Cang Hua finally appeared.
Bao Houan said, “Cang Hua, why are you hiding outside? Are you afraid to see me?”
Cang Hua didn’t answer. After a moment of silence, the door to the room opened.
Light shone inside, and the room instantly became bright. Bao Houan’s eyes took a while to adjust.
Two people walked inside. One was Cang Hua, and the other was a middle-aged man around the same height as Cang Hua.
He looked like a servant, and it was likely that he was the one who had been delivering noodles to Bao Houan these past few days.
“Young detective, what do you want to eat? Cang Hua asked, laughing.
“I want to eat deep-fried dough cakes,” Bao Houan said.
“Okay, I’ll have Uncle Yun buy some,” Cang Hua said.
“The deep-fried dough cakes I want to eat are only sold by one shop on Ping’an Road. Does this Uncle Yun know that place?”
Cang Hua looked at the servant next to him, and the servant shook his head.
Cang Hua laughed and said, “No worries, Uncle Yun will go and look for it. He will definitely find this shop.”
The servant nodded and said, “Okay, I’ll go look for it.”
“The shop is very hard to find. Would you dare let me go with Uncle Yun?” Bao Houan asked.
Cang Hua hesitated. He looked at Bao Houan and didn’t say anything.
“You don’t dare? Are you scared that I’ll run away?” Bao Houan asked.
Cang Hua laughed and said, “You can’t run away. I’ll go with you.”
Half an hour later, a black car drove out of the gray house.
The person driving was Cang Hua. The servant Uncle Yun did not come, and Bao Houan was sitting in the backseat.
He had his seatbelt on, with a large blanket over his body. Underneath the blanket, his arms and legs were tied.
From the outside, it just looked like he was a cold passenger with a large blanket.
This was very normal. After all, it was late autumn, and there was also a cold drizzle outside.
“If you’re so afraid of me escaping, why did you agree to let me out?” Bao Houan asked helplessly.
“I was just a little curious to see what exactly you wanted to do,“ Cang Hua said, laughing.
“Is it really about the deep-fried dough cakes?”
“It really is about the deep-fried dough cakes.”
“Really? Why? Are the deep-fried dough cakes from that shop really that good?”
Bao Houan looked at the rain outside the car window and said after a while, ..
.. “Cang Hua, have you ever experienced going without food for seven days and being so hungry you couldn’t walk?”
Cang Hua didn’t answer. He looked at Bao Houan and waited for him to continue speaking.
Bao Houan said, “I have. When I was 11, I came to Shanghai by myself with no money on me.
I didn’t eat anything for seven days, and I collapsed from hunger in front of a deep-fried dough cake store.
Two passersby walked by, and they saw me. One of the passersby bought a deep-fried dough cake from the shop for me.
That was the best deep-fried dough cake I’ve ever eaten in my life.
Later, whenever I was hungry, I would go to that shop and buy deep-fried dough cakes to eat.”
Cang Hua smiled and said, “That passerby was a good person. You came across a good person.”
Bao Houan nodded and said, “Yes, I came across a good person.”
